occurrences: Eurostat search results co-mingled enterprise cybersecurity outcome proportions with permitted source and license metadata.
SEC search results surfaced individual EDGAR filing records while resolving the agency reuse policy.
incidental_value_quarantine.handling: No outcome proportion, filing content, incident detail, loss value, organization, record, distribution, comparison, or prior agreement from those results was transcribed, persisted, summarized, or used. Outcome-bearing Eurostat sections and individual SEC filing results were quarantined and not opened as evidence.

preexcluded_paths.reason: The registration and End User Licence route remains deferred for unresolved commercial compatibility.

preexcluded_paths.reason: The exact 2017 record-level access tier is not currently advertised.

identities.title: VERIS Community Database
identities.license_evidence: The frozen official repository metadata states Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0. Commercial use is possible, but the share-alike obligation is reciprocal and therefore does not pass the frozen permissive-only product-rights gate.
identities.stop_reason: Share-alike terms caused mandatory rejection before schema review.

identities.title: EuRepoC Global Dataset of Cyber Incidents, version 1.3
identities.license_evidence: The frozen official Zenodo metadata has a blank license field; no direct record-level commercial-reuse grant is documented.
identities.stop_reason: Missing record-level license caused mandatory rejection before schema review.

identities.title: Warden Intrusion Detection Alert Capture, version 1.0.0
identities.license_evidence: The frozen official Zenodo metadata states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, which permits commercial reuse with attribution and no registration, permission, field-of-use, non-commercial, or reciprocal release restriction.

structural_result.reason: Alerts from a convenience set of sensor operators are not realized organization-period incidents and cannot supply explicit zero-event organization-years.

identities.title: Eurostat ICT Usage in Enterprises
identities.license_evidence: Eurostat directly authorizes commercial and non-commercial reuse of its statistical data with source acknowledgement, subject to enumerated exceptions; no written license procedure is required for the screened EU enterprise metadata and aggregates.

structural_result.unit: annual enterprise survey aggregated by national statistical institutes
structural_result.organization_period: present only in upstream national surveys
structural_result.reason: Eurostat explicitly states that only aggregated data are transmitted and no microdata are available at Eurostat level. The commercially reusable material is contextual aggregate evidence, not held-out organization-period records.

identities.title: Cyber Security Breaches Survey 2024
identities.publisher: UK Department for Science, Innovation and Technology and Home Office
identities.license_evidence: The GOV.UK publication and technical report use the Open Government Licence, but that publication license does not directly grant record-level response-data reuse. The corresponding record-level UK Data Service identity uses the separately deferred registration and End User Licence route.
identities.stop_reason: Publication-only license wording is not a record-level commercial grant and caused mandatory rejection before schema review.

identities.title: U.S. Census Annual Business Survey restricted-use firm microdata
identities.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau and National Center for Science and Engineering Statistics
identities.license_evidence: The official Census economic-data catalog classifies Annual Business Survey firm microdata as restricted-use. Census states that restricted business microdata are available only to qualified researchers with approved projects through secure Federal Statistical Research Data Centers or an authorized remote program.
identities.stop_reason: Restricted-use, qualified-researcher, and approved-project requirements caused mandatory rejection before schema review.

identities.title: SEC EDGAR Form 8-K Item 1.05 material cybersecurity incident disclosures
identities.license_evidence: The SEC directly states that Government-created sec.gov content and EDGAR public filing content are free to access and reuse without permission.

structural_result.unit: public-company filing concerning a registrant-determined material cybersecurity incident
structural_result.organization_period: a registrant-period frame is conceptually enumerable but not observed under a common zero-event ascertainment process
structural_result.explicit_population_denominator: Exchange Act registrant scope is defined, but filing coverage and compliance dates vary by registrant class
structural_result.incident_count: filing events and amendments are not a canonical all-incident count
structural_result.realized_loss: material impact or reasonably likely impact narrative is required, but a complete realized-loss amount is not required
structural_result.reason: Item 1.05 is triggered only after a registrant determines an incident is material, permits limited disclosure delay, and does not observe nonmaterial incidents. Absence of a filing cannot establish an explicit zero-incident organization-period under the frozen contract.

identities.title: HHS OCR Breach Portal
identities.publisher: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Office for Civil Rights
identities.license_evidence: Neither the frozen official portal metadata nor the bounded direct license search identified an explicit record-level commercial-reuse grant for the portal collection.
identities.stop_reason: Missing record-level commercial license caused mandatory rejection before schema review.

decision.result: No screened identity combines directly documented permissive commercial record-level rights with the frozen organization-period denominator, explicit zero-event, incident-count, stable-key, version, and lineage contract.
decision.bounded_negative_claim: This is a low-effort negative result for the eight disclosed identities and the exact frozen observation and commercial-rights contract. It is not a universal claim that no commercially compatible source can exist.
remaining_reversible_paths: A separately frozen aggregate external-coherence report can use commercially reusable official aggregates for descriptive context but cannot clear the record-level data gate.
A prospective panel or negotiated commercial data license can be reconsidered later under a new governance and budget decision.
The deferred UK Data Service path remains preserved but blocked until commercial-rights compatibility is deliberately resolved.
decision.handoff: Park further OPT-014 source work at the current data gate and prepare a separately authorized OPT-010 safety and evaluation step.
